title: Nebula PageBuilder Content Type
description: Declarative schema for a PageBuilder content type. Files live at view/adminhtml/content_type/<name>.json. Each file defines one content type registered with the Nebula PageBuilder registry: identity, tree-position rules, visual appearances, and default property values.

name.title: Content type name
name.description: Unique kebab-case identifier. Used as `data-content-type` attribute. MUST match the filename (with dashes replaced by underscores).

label.title: Display label
label.description: Human-readable name shown in the PageBuilder panel.

icon.title: Panel icon
icon.description: Font Awesome class string (e.g. `fa-solid fa-grip-lines`). Empty string hides the icon.

menuSection.title: Panel section
menuSection.description: Which section of the PageBuilder panel lists this type. Omit for system-only types.

sortOrder.title: Sort order
sortOrder.description: Integer ordering within the panel section.

isContainer.title: Is container
isContainer.description: Whether this type accepts child content.

isSystem.title: Is system-internal
isSystem.description: If true, the type is only reachable through explicit parent rules (not listed in the panel). Default: false.

parents.title: Parent policy
parents.description: Declares which content types may contain this one.

children.title: Children policy
children.description: Declares which content types this one may contain.

appearances.title: Appearances
appearances.description: Map of appearance_id -> appearance descriptor. Exactly one appearance MUST be marked `default: true`.

defaults.title: Default property values
defaults.description: Initial values applied to a new instance of this content type. Typically includes `appearance` plus type-specific settings.

treePolicy.title: Tree policy
treePolicy.description: Controls which content types are allowed on a given tree edge.

defaultPolicy.title: Default policy
defaultPolicy.description: Applied when a given content type is not listed in `allow` or `deny`.

allow.title: Allow list
allow.description: Content type names explicitly allowed (overrides defaultPolicy=deny).

deny.title: Deny list
deny.description: Content type names explicitly denied (overrides defaultPolicy=allow).

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: A visual variant of a content type with its own template and element-to-property bindings.

default.title: Is default appearance
default.description: Exactly one appearance per content type MUST be marked default.

label.title: Appearance label
label.description: Human-readable name shown in the appearance picker.

masterTemplate.title: Master template path
masterTemplate.description: phtml template relative to the PageBuilder templates root.

elements.title: Elements map
elements.description: Map of element_key -> element descriptor. `main` is always present.

element.title: Element
element.description: A rendered DOM node: its tag, which HTML attributes/CSS properties map to which content-type properties, and optional static styling.

tag.title: HTML tag
tag.description: Static HTML tag (e.g. `div`, `a`, `hr`). Use `dynamic` to resolve from a property at runtime via `tagSource`.

tagSource.title: Dynamic tag property
tagSource.description: Required when `tag` is `dynamic`. Names the property whose value becomes the tag name.

attributes.title: HTML attributes map
attributes.description: Map of attribute_name -> value or property source. Static strings become static attributes; object form binds to a property.

styles.title: CSS styles map
styles.description: Map of css_property -> property source. Each entry pulls a value from the content type's data.

staticStyles.title: Static CSS styles
staticStyles.description: CSS declarations applied unconditionally. Plain key/value strings.

cssSource.title: CSS class property
cssSource.description: Name of the content-type property whose value is split into dynamic CSS classes.

sourceBinding.title: Property source binding
sourceBinding.description: Binds an attribute/style to a content-type property, with an optional converter.

source.title: Property name
source.description: Content-type property key from which the value is read.

converter.title: Converter name
converter.description: Name of a converter registered with PageBuilder (e.g. backgroundImage, borderStyle, minHeight, margins, paddings, display).
